Name: (content patcher) slimes but they don't have eyes

Description:
this is a content patcher compatible version of an edit i made back in 2018 (see here: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2211]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2211[/url].) after looking at it for a while i realized i had the power and experience to rework this into something more convenient (AND add the new types of slimes.) enjoy!

(update: i figured out content patcher! this should no longer conflict with other slime-related mods! i also added a version without the red eyes in case you want TRULY eyeless slimes.)
